data.text: SCOE ideas to file: 1 Stable handshake + cache lint, 2 Runs-to-merge / first-pass rate, 3 Task card, 4 Acceptance criteria + readiness lint, 5 stop-after-N-failed-runs-and-ask knob (yes, file it). Task card = fields on tasks + a class table (not a new record kind). The slides effort/turn-cap class numbers may ship as overridable defaults, marked unsourced. Adoption reporting and installed-version visibility = a P-org-config deliverable (yes). A Vale-style prose gate = yes, as an optional companion.
